description: This file implements the QuicCryptoClientConfig class, managing QUIC client cryptographic configurations, including server config caching, client hello message generation, and key derivation.

classes.name: QuicCryptoClientConfig
classes.description: Manages QUIC client cryptographic configuration, including server config cache, client hello message creation, and key derivation.

classes.name: CachedState
classes.description: Represents cached server configuration state, including validity, expiration, and proof details.

methods.name: FillInchoateClientHello
methods.description: Constructs an initial ClientHello message with minimal information, including SNI, version, and optional proof nonce.

methods.name: FillClientHello
methods.description: Constructs a full ClientHello message based on cached server config, including key exchange and cryptographic parameters.

methods.name: CacheNewServerConfig
methods.description: Processes and caches a new server configuration message.

methods.name: ProcessRejection
methods.description: Handles server rejection messages and updates cached server config accordingly.

methods.name: ProcessServerHello
methods.description: Processes server hello messages, performs key exchange, and derives session keys.

methods.name: proof_verifier
methods.description: Returns the proof verifier used for server proof validation.

methods.name: ssl_ctx
methods.description: Returns the SSL context used for TLS connections.

methods.name: InitializeFrom
methods.description: Initializes cached state from a canonical configuration.

methods.name: AddCanonicalSuffix
methods.description: Adds a suffix to identify canonical server names.

methods.name: PopulateFromCanonicalConfig
methods.description: Populates cached state from a canonical server configuration based on suffix matching.
